info.title: Fullstack Simple API
info.description: Minimal fullstack template API for Moses platform

servers.description: Canonical API base. MUST stay base-path-free: the platform's workspace-tool proxy prepends MOSES_BASE_PATH itself (CHAT-8qiu0). Paths below are relative to this base — the platform's openapi_parser folds servers[0].url + path into the registered endpoint path.

get.summary: Get app status and Moses context
List all items for the current tenant
get.description: Returns all items scoped to the tenant pinned by the deploy-time MOSES_TENANT_ID env (CHAT-pxeo.12). The X-Moses-Tenant-ID header, if present, is audit-only.

parameters.name: X-Moses-Tenant-ID
parameters.description: Caller-context tenant audit header (CHAT-pxeo.12). Audit-only on the user-facing path; NOT authoritative for storage. Storage keys come from the deploy-pinned MOSES_TENANT_ID env. When set and disagreeing with the env, write handlers return 403 {error:tenant_mismatch,code:E_TENANT_MISMATCH} (gated by MOSES_STRICT_TENANT_CHECK).
